entries.title: The Four Pillars (Saju Palja)
entries.content: Saju turns your birth year, month, day and hour into four 'pillars' made of eight characters. Traditionally it is read as a map of the moment you were born.
entries.source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Gunghap: Understanding Korean Marital Compatibility & Saju
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: A tool for self-reflection
entries.content: Classical Saju study (Ziping) treats the chart as a personality framework for reflection, not a fixed fate. It is used to think about your tendencies and friction points.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: True solar time
entries.content: Accurate charts adjust clock time to the sun's real position at your birth city (longitude and the equation of time). Near the edge of a two-hour block this can change the hour pillar.
entries.source: True Solar Time in Bazi: When Correction Changes a Pillar; BaziInsight hour pillar guide
entries.label: Calculation rule

entries.title: The Day Master
entries.content: The heavenly stem of your day pillar is called the Day Master and represents your core self. The rest of the chart is read in relation to it.
entries.source: How to Read Marital Harmony (Gunghap 3) - Korea Times; Saju Cafe in Seoul guide
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
